QuestInfo.name: [Collector's Request] Hero's Potion
QuestInfo.0: The Collector sends you a letter. Could it be about Sayram's relics?
QuestInfo.1: The Collector says the powers have been extracted into a potion thanks to the help of some alchemists.
QuestInfo.2: The Collector said the power of Sayram and Aurelia's relics was extracted into the form of a potion. He assured you it was a very expensive process... You can purchase it from the Collector if you are in need of the potion.

1.msg: Good news! Through what turned out to be very expensive means, the power of the relics were extracted by alchemists into a potion! The results are frankly astounding.

2.msg: However, it hurt my bottom line more than I care to admit. I'll need some assistance recouping the costs.

3.msg: You can purchase from me whenever you'd like.\r\nThanks again for your help!

yes.0: You can purchase from me whenever you'd like.\r\nThanks again for your help!
